chapter: Joe Martini and Triangle Jazz Blues
title: Who Joe Martini was; arranger and record of Triangle Jazz Blues
summary: Leclerc remembers Martini as a piano teacher and gifted transcriber, not a cafe player. They guess someone else orchestrated Triangle Jazz Blues for the band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
